verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports confirm Bitbucket has web-based source browsing, a source page, and a commits view with a history graph. One user calls source browsing slow and click-heavy, which is a usability complaint, not a contradiction. Nothing in the pack documents line-by-line blame. missing for 10: evidence of a line-by-line blame view, first-party documentation of file browsing and commit history, recent hands-on corroboration (the reports are from old HN threads).

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse repository files, commit history, and line-by-line blame in the web interface
